Proposition
[Curvature evolution] 1. ch2:5.1 Source: topping:page-0042, topping:page-0043 \group topping-background

Under $\partial _tg=-2\Ric $, \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}\Rm =\Delta \Rm +\Rm *\Rm . \] In components, \begin{align*} \frac{\partial }{\partial t}\Rm (X,Y,W,Z)={}& (\Delta \Rm )(X,Y,W,Z)\\ & -\Ric (R(X,Y)W,Z)+\Ric (R(X,Y)Z,W)\\ & -\Ric (R(W,Z)X,Y)+\Ric (R(W,Z)Y,X)\\ & +2\bigl(B(X,Y,W,Z)-B(X,Y,Z,W)\\ & \qquad +B(X,W,Y,Z)-B(X,Z,Y,W)\bigr). \end{align*}
